program_name: Economics and Communication for Management and Innovation (Economia e Comunicazione per il Management e l'Innovazione)
campus: ROME - taught entirely at Sapienza Università di Roma under an inter-university agreement. Department of record at UNITUS: DEIM (Dipartimento di Economia, Ingegneria, Società e Impresa). [uncertain] IMPORTANT: classes are NOT delivered in Viterbo - all disciplinary and laboratory activities take place at the Rome campus per Art. 3 of the Sapienza-Tuscia convention. Sapienza is also the designated 'sede amministrativa' (administrative headquarters) handling enrolment, fees, and student records (Art. 4 of the convention).
academic_requirements: [uncertain] A prior bachelor's-level degree (Laurea) or recognized equivalent foreign qualification is required (implicit for LM-77 admission generally; not spelled out with specific CFU/SSD thresholds on any unitus.it source found). No official unitus.it page or PDF (including the DEIM 'Regulations' listing page and the two unitus.it-hosted PDFs found for this specific program - the promotional brochure and the Sapienza-Tuscia inter-university convention) publishes curricular CFU/SSD prerequisite thresholds for this LM-77 programme, unlike other UNITUS LM-77 programmes at DEIM (e.g. 'Amministrazione, finanza e controllo' and 'Marketing e qualità', both LM-77, which do have dedicated regulation PDFs on that page). Admission proceeds via a mandatory oral interview (Colloquio orale) rather than a published numeric CFU checklist. Foreign qualifications would be expected to require standard equivalency documentation (Dichiarazione di Valore / CIMEA Statement of Comparability) per the university-wide baseline, but this is not confirmed specifically for this programme on unitus.it.
language_requirements: English proficiency at CEFR B2 level per the university-wide baseline (accepted certificates: IELTS, TOEFL, TCL, Cambridge First, PTE Academic, Oxford Test of English, Aptis ESOL General/Advanced; or documentation of a prior EMI - English as Medium of Instruction - degree). No Italian language requirement is stated, consistent with this being a fully English-taught programme. [uncertain] No programme-specific English test/score table was found on unitus.it for this programme (unlike some other UNITUS LM programmes); the oral interview itself is conducted about the course content, not explicitly described as a language-proficiency test.
entry_exam_or_test: Mandatory oral interview ('Colloquio orale', per the official field on the program page). Booked via the university-wide Interview Booking form at https://www.unitus.it/en/join-unitus/how-to-enroll/interview-booking/, where 'ECONOMICS AND COMMUNICATION FOR MANAGEMENT AND INNOVATION (Laurea Magistrale LM-77)' is confirmed as a selectable option in the programme dropdown. No TOLC, no numerus clausus/bando. [uncertain] No further detail (format, topics, online vs in-person, scoring threshold) is published on unitus.it for this specific programme.
application_deadline_eu: [uncertain] No programme-specific application deadline is published on the official unitus.it program page (admission is rolling, gated by the oral interview, not a call/bando). University-wide 2026/2027 enrolment calendar applies: enrolment opens 2026-08-01, deadline for 1st-year Master's students 2026-12-29, with extension to 2027-02-28 for January/February graduates.
application_deadline_non_eu: [uncertain] No programme-specific deadline published. University-wide 2026/2027 calendar applies: non-EU visa application cutoff at the consulate is 2026-11-30; onsite enrolment via the International Students Desk opens 2026-08-01; Universitaly pre-enrolment is open for a.y. 2026/2027 (Universitaly itself typically opens around April/May). Given that Sapienza is the administrative headquarters for this specific inter-university programme (per Art. 4 of the Sapienza-Tuscia convention), non-EU applicants should also verify whether Sapienza's own (out-of-scope) enrolment portal imposes a different or additional deadline - this could not be checked because Sapienza's site is outside this project's source scope.
required_documents: Completed interview booking request (Interview Booking form) to schedule the mandatory oral interview
Prior degree diploma / transcript per the university-wide baseline (certified copy + Apostille/legalization + certified Italian translation, OR CIMEA Statement of Verification)
Declaration of Value (Dichiarazione di Valore) OR CIMEA Statement of Comparability OR ARDI Statement of Correspondence (for foreign qualifications)
Diploma Supplement (can substitute the Declaration of Value if legalized)
English language certificate or EMI documentation

tuition_or_fees_link.note: [uncertain] This is the general UNITUS fees page (ISEEUP income-based tiered tuition; non-EU flat bands of EUR 600/1,050/1,500/1,950 per year by country). However, per Art. 4 of the Sapienza-Tuscia inter-university convention, Sapienza Università di Roma is the 'sede amministrativa' responsible for setting and collecting this programme's fees ('definire l'ammontare ed incassare le tasse e i contributi degli studenti'), so actual tuition amounts for this specific programme may be governed by Sapienza's own fee regulations, which are out of scope for this project (Sapienza's site is not a primary source per project rules).
